name: sled 45 degrees narrow stance leg press
description: A 45 degree sled leg press with feet close together to emphasise the quads.
instructions: Sit in the sled with your back flat on the pad and feet close together on the platform.
Lower the sled until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking your knees.
Keep your hips on the seat.
